info.title: Unified SmartPOS API
info.description:
Unified SmartPOS REST API (v1) for the web (React) and mobile (Expo) clients.

**Authentication** — Mobile/API clients: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with `device_name` and send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Browser SPA on a domain listed in `SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS`: `GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie`, then log in without `device_name` and send the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header.

**Tenancy** — Business data lives under `/api/v1/tenants/{tenant}`. The caller needs an active membership; otherwise the API answers `404`. Each endpoint lists the permission it requires, and branch-scoped data is limited to the member's authorized branches. `GET /tenants/{tenant}/context` returns the caller's permissions and branches.

**Money** — Amounts are decimal strings (`"112.00"`), never floats. Quantities have 3 decimals, costs have 4.

**Idempotency** — `POST /tenants/{tenant}/sales` requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. Retrying with the same key and body returns the original sale (`200`, `Idempotent-Replayed: true`). Reusing the key with a different body returns `409`.

**Errors** — `401` unauthenticated, `403` missing permission or branch access, `404` not found or not your business, `409` idempotency conflict, `422` validation (`errors`) or business rule (`code`, e.g. `INSUFFICIENT_STOCK`), `429` rate limited.

post.description:
Creates the user, the business, a main branch, a default register and the owner membership
in one transaction. Send `device_name` to receive a bearer token (mobile); omit it from a
stateful SPA origin to be logged in with a session cookie instead.

post.description:
Identify with `email`, or (company-managed staff) `business_code` + `username`, where `username` may also be
the employee ID. Owners, managers and HR (User & Access Manager, or any role with administrative permissions)
must use their email; a correct username password for them is refused with a hint.
With `device_name`: returns a personal access token for `Authorization: Bearer`.
Without it (SPA on a stateful domain, after GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie): starts a session.

Cashiers (`sales.view`) see their own sales; `sales.view_all` sees all sales in authorized branches.
Filters: `date_from`, `date_to` (business date, YYYY-MM-DD), `branch_id`, `cashier_id`, `status`,

post.description:
Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (8-100 chars, unique per sale attempt). Retrying with the same
key and body returns the original sale with HTTP 200 and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; the same key
with a different body returns 409. Requires `sales.create` at the register's branch and an open
shift on the register.
